name: Battle Note
source:
A Battle Note type monster girl. This Battle Note is one of [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid's[/url] most trusted and fierce warriors. She is happy when Baron Squid finally gives up trying to marry the other girls of Squid Paradise in order to propose to her because she hopes to marry someone strong. Her biggest enemy and threat is [url=http://vndb.org/c13594]Valkyrie[/url].

[spoiler]When [url=http://vndb.org/c13607]Lady Killer[/url] tries to murder [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] she recognizes Leo's strength and kindness and switches sides killing Lady Killer in the process.[/spoiler]
